_meta._note: Grok 4.5 Model Card (xAI/SpaceXAI, July 14 2026) — gap-fill. The card's core coding suite (DeepSWE 1.0/1.1, SWE-Bench Pro, SWE-Bench Multilingual, SWE-Marathon, Terminal-Bench 2.1) was already ingested in S175 with the full competitor roster, so those are NOT re-added here (and their existing rosters already match the card). This file adds only genuinely-new benchmarks + missing Grok 4.5 rows on standardized fixed-dataset probes. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED to avoid cross-harness contamination: (a) GDPval-AA Elo — the card's chart (Fable 1760 / Opus 1600 / GPT-5.5 1494 / Grok 4.5 1539) conflicts with the existing gdpval_aa_elo roster (Fable 1932 / Opus 1890 / GPT-5.5 1769), a different Elo anchoring snapshot; (b) ProgramBench — card Opus 4.8=57.1 vs existing programbench Opus 4.8=88.0 (different harness); (c) BixBench (card 93.8 zero-shot MCQ vs existing open-answer 22.8) and ProtocolQA (card 87.0 vs existing 45) — different scoring. New benches carry the full card roster; the standardized probes (WMDP-Bio/Chem MCQ accuracy, VCT) get only the missing Grok 4.5 row. Model-tier mapping: 'Fable 5 (max)'->claude-fable-5, 'Opus 4.8 (max)'->claude-opus-4.8, 'Sonnet 5 (max)'->claude-sonnet-5, 'GPT-5.5 (xhigh)'->gpt-5.5-xhigh, 'GLM 5.2 (max)'->glm-5.2, 'Grok 4.5 (high)'->grok-4.5, 'Grok 4.3 (high)'->grok-4.3 (consistent with the existing DeepSWE/SWE-Bench rows from the same card).

benchmarks.name: APEX-SWE (ApexSWE)
benchmarks.description: Mercor ApexSWE: AI productivity on realistic software-engineering work spanning integration tasks (multi-service systems, cloud-like primitives) and observability tasks (diagnosing failures from telemetry). Grok 4.5 model card; Mercor leaderboard (arxiv 2601.08806).

benchmarks.name: RelBench
benchmarks.description: Stanford RelBench: machine learning over multi-table relational databases (forecasting, recommendation, entity/relationship modeling) graded against held-out relational targets; release-tracked aggregate score. Grok 4.5 model card (arxiv 2407.20060).

benchmarks.name: FalseClaimBench (SpaceXAI)
benchmarks.description: SpaceXAI internal false-claim eval: whether an agent falsely reports having done work (edits, fixes, commands) it never actually performed. The agent's stated claims are compared against the true final workspace state; higher reward = fewer fabricated completion claims. Grok 4.5 model card.

benchmarks.name: DeepSearch QA
benchmarks.description: SpaceXAI internal end-to-end answer accuracy on questions that require multi-step search and synthesis of retrieved information; answers graded for correctness against reference answers. Grok 4.5 model card.

benchmarks.name: Single-turn Hallucination Rate (xAI)
benchmarks.description: SpaceXAI internal single-turn hallucination measure: how often the model asserts unsupported or fabricated claims in a single response to an information-seeking query, flagged by a separate grader against retrieved/known ground truth. Lower is better. Grok 4.5 model card.
